name: My Girlfriend Meets My Friend
source:
Due to urgent repairs on her apartment, the protagonist's girlfriend, Hannah, is forced to relocate on short notice. With nowhere else to go, she moves into the apartment shared by the protagonist and his roommate, Ace.

While the protagonist is stuck working extended overtime hours at the office for his demanding boss, he stays connected through his phone. Through texts, photo updates, and remote camera feeds, he watches as the dynamic between his girlfriend and his roommate steadily shifts in his absence.
